evidence.why: Initial capture and current-state setter call.
Setter applies the mapped synth sound mode.

facts.rationale: The menu binding distinguishes current editable state from a saved restoration value.
facts.value: Applies the Sound Test menu's current sound-mode selection from un_804D6DBC through lbAudioAx_80024C08. The selection is initialized from the audio subsystem but is also directly bound to the editable Sound Mode menu entry; this callback does not demonstrate restoration of an immutable pre-session backup.
